name: Blitz
tagline: A first-person shooter controlled by a cardboard gun with a printed marker and a webcam.
problem: VR gear is expensive or unavailable, especially for kids.
solution: The webcam tracks a printed fiducial marker on a cardboard gun in six degrees of freedom to aim; a recoil gesture fires and a fist gesture reloads, in a 3D game.
demo_moment: Team-described: aim the cardboard gun and shoot targets on screen.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Constraint-driven: no VR gear on the trip, so they built with cardboard.

lessons: A cheap physical prop plus solid tracking delivers most of the VR feeling.
